about:
hg medical USA is headquartered in Holland, Michigan. The company was formed after Wright Medical acquired the DARCO implant division, though the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not specified in available sources.

The company manufactures orthopedic implants for bone surgery at two production sites: Raisting, Germany, and Huntington, West Virginia. It processes titanium, stainless steel, and PEEK using modern machining centers and automated milling equipment. Both facilities operate independent quality management systems certified to ISO 13485 and compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 820, and have undergone full FDA audits.

hg medical serves the orthopedic implant and medical device markets, supplying both global market leaders and dynamic startups. Its customer base includes original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) that require traceable, regulatory-compliant components for surgical applications.

The firm emphasizes a "Best in Class" quality claim, highlighting rigorous internal audits, multiple customer audits each year, and full traceability. Its differentiation rests on independent, audited quality systems at each site, FDA compliance, and automated U.S. milling capacity.
